## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues where applicable.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. For documentation-only changes, check formatting and links. Explain any checks not run.

## Compatibility

Describe public API changes, migration steps or other compatibility considerations, or state that there are none.

## Screenshots or reproduction

Include before/after screenshots for visible changes or a minimal reproduction for browser behavior, when applicable.
